# PlexMCP (plex-mcp-advanced)

> FastMCP 3.1 MCP server for Plex Media Server: portmanteau tools (libraries, media, search, streaming, RAG), server-side sampling (`PLEX_SAMPLING_BASE_URL` / Ollama), agentic workflows (`agentic_plex_workflow`, `plex_natural_assistant`), optional webapp (FastAPI + Next.js). Transports: stdio and HTTP; web UI uses backend + frontend on fleet ports **10740** / **10741**.

**Full detail (tools, env, architecture, troubleshooting): see [`llms-full.txt`](llms-full.txt).**

## Tools (summary)

Portmanteau tools include `plex_library`, `plex_media`, `plex_search`, `plex_streaming`, `plex_user`, `plex_playlist`, `plex_metadata`, `plex_server`, `plex_performance`, `plex_rag`, `plex_help`, `agentic_plex_workflow`, `plex_natural_assistant`, and others. Discovery: `plex_help(operation="list_tools")`.

See **§ Tools** in [`llms-full.txt`](llms-full.txt).

## Sampling & RAG

- Sampling: configure `PLEX_SAMPLING_BASE_URL`, `PLEX_SAMPLING_MODEL`; optional `PLEX_SAMPLING_USE_CLIENT_LLM=1`; aligns with `LLM_BASE_URL` when unset.
- RAG: `plex_rag` — LanceDB metadata index; optional bridge to mcp-central-docs vector code — see README “RAG / Semantic search”.

## Ports (webapp)

| Service   | Port   |
|-----------|--------|
| Backend   | 10740  |
| Frontend  | 10741  |

## Fleet commands

- `uv sync` / `just sync` — install from lockfile
- `just run` — MCP server
- `just webapp` — browser UI
- `just check` — ruff + pytest

See [`justfile`](justfile).
